object_description: permeable perimeter crown around a compact school volume
design_condition: The school occupies the northwestern edge of the block interior, preserving existing operations while forming a green heart connected to surrounding streets and paths.

positive.statement: The permeable built front adapts particularly well to the surrounding context.

position.rationale: Northwestern placement and open perimeter suggest a porous urban-facing built edge.

positive.statement: The location provides a particularly relevant operational solution by allowing existing facilities to remain in use.

position.rationale: Operational continuity is anchored to the school’s stated northwestern block-edge location.

positive.statement: The school’s placement makes clever and economical use of the triangular block while maximizing surrounding green space.

position.target: triangular block and surrounding green space
position.rationale: Top view visibly shows a triangular perimeter arrangement around a central open green area.

positive.statement: The clear alignments and simple whole fit naturally into the preserved environment.

position.rationale: Orthographic views show a compact, clearly aligned perimeter volume with consistent elevation.

positive.statement: The school is connected clearly to the neighborhood by primary and secondary paths.

position.rationale: Perimeter and internal point alignments provide a plausible connection zone toward surrounding streets.

positive.statement: The south-side passageways successfully combine sun protection, escape routes, and exterior courtyard areas.

position.rationale: The south elevation constrains the passageways to the lower southern facade and adjacent exterior space.

negative.statement: The jury considers that a semi-buried parking installation would better protect the overall composition.

position.rationale: Parking is not distinguishable; approximate lower eastern site surface represents the proposed intervention.

negative.statement: The generous crossing hall is cluttered to the point of saturation, and the stair flights appear undersized.

position.rationale: Interior circulation is not identifiable, so the central building region is used as a constrained proxy.

negative.statement: The ground floor is particularly dark.

position.rationale: Lower elevation bands in the sampled envelope anchor the daylight judgment to the ground level.

negative.statement: The additional classroom and very large hall tend to inflate the volume to be built.

position.target: additional classroom and very large hall
position.rationale: Internal program is absent; upper northwestern volume is a constrained proxy for added bulk.

negative.statement: The future of the preserved plane-tree mall and the proposed concentration of play equipment require reconsideration.

position.rationale: Landscape elements are not individually visible; central open-space surface represents the reconsidered site area.
